name: mcp-speechmatics-transcribe

tools.name: transcribe
tools.description: Transcribe local audio and video files through the Speechmatics Batch API. Return paths to raw JSON, segments, WebVTT subtitles, and Markdown.

file.description: Absolute path to a local audio or video file.

model.description: Configured default: enhanced. enhanced: highest accuracy for a selected language. standard: faster processing and archival transcription. melia-1: MULTILANGUAGE, language switching within recordings. oak-1: MULTILANGUAGE, healthcare recordings. Use language=multi for melia-1 and oak-1; neither supports audio events.

language.description: Configured default: pl. Language code such as pl or en for enhanced/standard. Use multi for MULTILANGUAGE models melia-1 and oak-1.

disableDiarization.description: Configured speaker diarization: enabled. Set true to disable it. Omit or pass false to use the server setting.

audioEvents.description: Configured default: true. Detect laughter, music, and applause with Standard/Enhanced. Automatically disabled for melia-1/oak-1. Set false to disable.

convertToMp3.description: Configured default: false. Convert non-MP3 files with system FFmpeg before uploading.

timeoutSeconds.description: Configured default: 900 seconds. Upload and API processing timeout, independent of recording duration.

tools.name: token_status
tools.description: Check configured tokens and read Batch usage from Speechmatics. Excluded tokens are reported without API requests. Identity is the configured login or a masked token. API access does not guarantee funds for transcription. Usage is returned in the API's scope, not attributed exclusively to a key. This read-only check does not change rotation, exclusions, or logs.

since.description: Inclusive start date YYYY-MM-DD. Defaults to the first day of the current UTC month.

until.description: Inclusive end date YYYY-MM-DD. Defaults explicitly to today in UTC, including the current day's usage.

instructions: Transcribe local audio and video files through the Speechmatics Batch API.
